title: Reinstatement, Sale and Deficiency Timetable for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tiers
content:
**Repossession rights and sale timetable — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

After repossession of a vehicle financed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract, the following tier figures apply to reinstatement, the sale and any deficiency.

### Reinstatement by tier

| Tier | Company reinstatement window (calendar days after repossession) | Maximum company-discretion reinstatements over the life of the contract |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 10 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 10 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 10 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 15 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 15 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 21 | 2 |

### Figures common to every tier

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Days past due on another Kestrel account at which a discretionary reinstatement is withheld | 30 days |
| Company minimum notice period: calendar days between the notice of intent to sell and the sale | 15 calendar days |
| Calendar days after the sale within which a surplus is refunded | 30 calendar days |
| Minimum settlement percentage for the tier (minimum lump-sum settlement as a percent of the deficiency balance) | 55 percent |
| Calendar days after the sale before an unpaid deficiency is charged off | 90 calendar days |

### Notes

- Tier 1+ is the only tier with a 21-day company window and two company-discretion reinstatements; Tier 2 and Tier 1 have a 15-day window; Tier 5, Tier 4 and Tier 3 a 10-day window.
- The company window and the company minimum notice period are the company's own periods; a contract may also record a state reinstatement period or a state notice period of its own.
